Name: WORLD_MAP_PIECE_PARAM_ST
Description: The world map fragments: each row is one piece that uncovers part of a map layer. Row ID = layer group × 100 + piece number: group 0 the Lands Between, 1 the underground, 10 the Land of Shadow; only piece numbers 0–31 take part (one bit each). Which map tiles a piece uncovers comes from the map textures, not from this param. The Land of Shadow group's row 70 (1070) is special: it only adds its traversal area while its flag is on.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Open - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: While this flag is on, the piece is uncovered on its map layer. 0 or -1: never uncovered. Retail: 62000–62084, one per piece.

Fields.Name: Open - Traversal Area - X Min
Fields.Description: Left edge (X min) of the traversal area added when the piece is uncovered, in world map coordinates. The map screen's area is the bounding box of every uncovered piece's rectangle; a rectangle with no width and no height is ignored.

Fields.Name: Open - Traversal Area - X Max
Fields.Description: Right edge (X max) of the traversal area added when the piece is uncovered, in world map coordinates. See Open - Traversal Area - X Min.

Fields.Name: Open - Traversal Area - Y Min
Fields.Description: Top edge (Y min) of the traversal area added when the piece is uncovered, in world map coordinates (Y grows southward). See Open - Traversal Area - X Min.

Fields.Name: Open - Traversal Area - Y Max
Fields.Description: Bottom edge (Y max) of the traversal area added when the piece is uncovered, in world map coordinates. See Open - Traversal Area - X Min.

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: When the map is opened with this flag on, the "map fragment acquired" dialog plays for this piece, then the game turns the flag off. The dialog text is fixed per row ID (GR_Dialogues 241000 onward), not set here. 0 or -1: no dialog.

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Display Scale
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 1 on every row).

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Center X Coordinate
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 0 on every row).

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Center Y Coordinate
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 0 on every row).

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Display Resource Scale
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 1 on every row).

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Resource Offset X
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 0 on every row).

Fields.Name: Acquisition - Resource Offset Y
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (retail 0 on every row).
